claim_summary: UK AISI reports a 3.6-minute no-CoT math time horizon for GPT-5.6 Sol.
The same UK AISI statement reports 2.3 minutes for GPT-5.5.
Anthropic states that Fable 5 and Mythos 5 use the same underlying model weights; Fable adds safeguards.
Client apps can route classifier-triggering Fable requests to Opus 4.8; the Messages API has no automatic fallback by default.
Anthropic classifies GPQA Diamond as saturated and plans to stop reporting it for future models.
